setupAddins.name: CA Debugger
setupAddins.description: Standalone debugger for the Clarion IDE: native gutter breakpoints, stepping, call stack with procedure names, and watch-by-name over the TSWD debug engine. Installs independently - no Clarion Assistant required. Requires the Microsoft WebView2 runtime. Ships as a Windows installer covering Clarion 10, 11 and 12.
setupAddins.author: ClarionLive
